question: Identify the antonym of "Harass":
solution:
The correct answer is: **Comfort**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The word **"Harass"** means to bother, disturb, or subject someone to constant or repeated trouble or attack. (परेशान करना)
 
 
• **Example:** The employees complained about being harassed by their manager.
 
 
• The word **"Comfort"** means to provide relief, consolation, or a sense of ease to someone in distress or discomfort. (सांत्वना देना)
 
 
• **Example:** She tried to comfort her friend after the loss of her pet.
